verdict: Ads have been dark 18 days; overdue setup work is the core blocker.
narrative: All paid advertising stopped on September 17 and has not run since — 18 consecutive days with zero spend and zero new leads from paid channels. The 48 leads and $16.20 cost per lead shown in the 28-day totals were earned entirely in the first 10 days of the window, before the blackout. Several setup milestones — including conversion tracking, audience infrastructure, and CRM connections — passed their due dates without going live, and those gaps are what's holding campaigns off. Work to close those milestones is underway now, and ads are targeted to resume once the infrastructure is confirmed. Expect a full restart of Meta and Google activity this period, with cleaner conversion data feeding both platforms once tracking is live.

highlights.phrase: consecutive days with no paid ads running as of this report
leads received this period, all driven by Meta before September 17
spent on Google Ads this period with zero conversions recorded

watch_item.issue: Google Ads has spent $201 this period and returned no measurable conversions — conversion tracking was never activated, so results could not be optimized.
watch_item.fix: Offline conversion import and audience infrastructure are being brought live this month so Google can begin optimizing to real outcomes.
